meta.description: Paris By Night 127 - The 35-Year Journey (Part 2) is the 135th Paris By Night program (including special programs) produced and released by Thuy Nga Center. The program is considered one of the three largest and most spectacular programs of the center in 2018, and is the sequel to the series of programs on the theme of the 35-year journey of Paris By Night programs.
